about_short_description.short_description: Bond is an enterprise-grade financial technology platform streamlining the integration between brands and banks.

product.name: Bond Embedded Financial Platform
product.description: An API-driven platform that enables brands and software companies to embed banking, credit, card issuing, and money-movement capabilities into their products.

product.name: Bond Credit
product.description: A credit infrastructure service for creating consumer and commercial credit programs, including underwriting, decisioning, and credit card program management.

product.name: Bond Issuing
product.description: A card-issuing service for creating and managing branded virtual and physical debit, prepaid, secured charge, and credit cards.

product.name: Bond Banking
product.description: A banking infrastructure service for launching deposit, balance, and rewards accounts with account details, balances, and access to U.S. ATMs.

product.name: Bond Pay
product.description: A money-movement service for transferring funds between accounts and cards and making payments on behalf of customers.

product.name: Consumer Secured Credit Card
product.description: A secured consumer credit card program that uses identity verification, Bond underwriting, and instant decisioning to support credit-building use cases.
